title: Gus and the Town on the Rug
synopsis: The friends assemble their town from an old cardboard carton, blocks, a towel, and a toy dump truck. The walking bridge and long vehicle road need different lines on a map.
continuity_state: Before: The friends have wondered why Dan's vehicle route to the farm differs from their bridge route; Gus has suggested a new neighborhood map but there is not yet a complete drawing. After: A rainy morning produces a temporary toy town on Rex's rug using his preserved cardboard carton, old wooden toy dump truck, blocks, and props. Jack draws separate road and walking-path lines. The toy town is packed away; the drawn cardboard map is rolled for a meeting with Mr. Lee.
